subtitle: Coldwater prawns with Marie Rose sauce, iceberg lettuce and buttered bread, suited to diners wanting a lighter starter.

components.name: Coldwater prawns
components.note: Sweet, delicate coldwater prawns provide the soft texture and seafood flavour at the centre of this starter.

components.name: Marie Rose sauce
components.note: The rich Marie Rose sauce coats the prawns, adding tanginess and a slight sweetness to each mouthful.

components.name: Iceberg lettuce
components.note: A bed of crisp iceberg lettuce gives a crunchy contrast to the soft prawns and rich sauce.

components.name: Buttered bread
components.note: Slices of buttered bread accompany the prawns and give you something to scoop up the remaining sauce.

taste:
This prawn cocktail combines delicate seafood sweetness with a rich, tangy sauce and crisp lettuce. The coldwater prawns have a soft texture, while the Marie Rose coating brings a slightly sweet finish alongside its tanginess. Iceberg lettuce underneath provides the crunch, giving each forkful a contrast rather than leaving the prawns and sauce to carry the whole plate.

Buttered bread makes the serving more than prawns on a bed of leaves. Use it to scoop up the sauce or alternate it with mouthfuls of seafood and lettuce. The overall character is light and refreshing, but the rich sauce remains a noticeable part of the flavour. It suits someone who enjoys a classic retro starter with contrasting textures.
